STEP 1 - Scene: A takeout-style meal of stir-fried chicken with vegetables (bell pepper, carrot, green pepper) over fried or steamed rice, served on a white compostable plate on a grey tray. Photographed from a fairly high, near-overhead angle with a color calibration card beside it.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is an oval-ish white plate about 22 cm across its long axis (similar to a side plate). Using ~20 cm diameter, area = 3.14 x 10^2 = 314 cm^2. The tray and paper cone are not used for scale.

STEP 3 - Items: (a) rice (mixed with small bits of egg/grain, lightly coloured), (b) chicken pieces in brown sauce, (c) bell pepper and green vegetables, (d) carrot pieces, (e) sauce.

STEP 4 - Area: Rice ~40% of plate, chicken ~25%, mixed vegetables ~8%, carrot ~2%, sauce overlay included with the above. Total food coverage ~70% of the plate area (about 220 cm^2).

STEP 5 - Volume: Rice 40% = 126 cm^2 x 2 cm = 252 ml. Chicken 25% = 79 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 118 ml. Vegetables 8% = 25 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 38 ml. Carrot 2% = 6 cm^2 x 1 cm = 6 ml. Sauce ~ 15 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Rice 252 ml x 0.8 = 202 g. Chicken 118 ml x 0.95 = 112 g. Vegetables 38 ml x 0.6 = 23 g. Carrot 6 ml x 0.6 = 4 g. Sauce 15 ml x 1.0 = 15 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Fried rice ~160 kcal/100 g: 202 g → 323 kcal. Stir-fried chicken (with some coating and oil) ~180 kcal/100 g: 112 g → 202 kcal. Mixed bell peppers ~30 kcal/100 g: 23 g → 7 kcal. Carrot ~35 kcal/100 g: 4 g → 1 kcal. Sauce ~100 kcal/100 g: 15 g → 15 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total about 356 g and roughly 548 kcal, plausible for a side-plate-sized takeout portion of stir-fry and rice that covers about 70% of the plate.
